tool-discovery.form_intro: Choose an authorized node to read its tools and review the configuration, or import a local inventory. New registrations stay paused and require a separate review to enable.
tool-discovery.manual_inventory: Paste or import a JSON inventory
tool-discovery.title: Detect node tools
tool-discovery.intro: Read the node's latest report and fill available configurations. This does not install tools or start tasks.
tool-discovery.authorization_required: The node's current authorization cannot be confirmed. Refresh the node list or choose another node.
tool-discovery.choose_worker: Choose an execution node to read its reported tools automatically.
tool-discovery.fresh_empty: The node reported no tools. Check installation and tool configuration on that node, then report again.
tool-discovery.none_available: No reported tools are available. Review the reasons below, resolve them on the node and read again.
tool-discovery.expired: This report expired. Check that the node is running and read again, or import a local inventory.
tool-discovery.stale: The node report expired. Historical configurations will not be adopted. Check the node connection and credential, then read again.
tool-discovery.unreported: This node has not reported tools. Start its configured Runner and read again after it reports, or import a local inventory.
tool-discovery.adopt: Replace current inventory with this report
tool-discovery.adopted_hint: The report is filled below; a sole available tool is selected automatically. Review and register it. New configurations remain paused.
tool-discovery.local_help: No results? Use a local inventory
tool-discovery.local_help_text: Check that the Runner connects to this project with the current node credential. You can also run the read-only probe below on the node, then paste its output or import a saved JSON file. Tool paths, arguments and environment values stay on the node.
tool-discovery.invalid_read: The report is incomplete or does not match the current node. Read again or use a locally generated inventory.
